name: Parloa
positioning: An enterprise AI agent platform for customer service, with design, simulation and monitoring tools, sold on custom consumption-based contracts.

pricing.model: Consumption-based (per minute for voice, per interaction for chat) on custom volume commitments
pricing.headline: Per-minute voice pricing with rates that vary by use-case complexity; no public rate, custom plans via sales.
planNotes: Pricing page: 'consumption-based pricing: per minute for voice and per interaction for chat'.
Rates reflect the complexity of each use case.
Customers pick a volume package that applies across use cases; outcome-based pricing is supported when it makes sense.
No standard plans: 'Pricing models are built around your specific deployment'.

strengths.claim: Vendor lists ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type 1 and 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, DORA, GDPR and EU AI Act coverage on its security page.
Data residency through 'Parloa Zones' so customer data can stay in a chosen region.
States 140+ languages and variants with direct SIP connectivity to telephony, CCaaS, PBX/UC and WebRTC.
Includes tooling for simulating and testing agents (Performance Lab) before updates or model changes.
Single volume commitment can be applied across multiple use cases without new contracts.

limitations.claim: Pricing is custom and built around the specific deployment rather than published standard plans.

integrations: Telephony, CCaaS and PBX/UC systems via SIP

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested on the security page: 'ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type 1 and 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, DORA, GDPR, and the EU AI Act'. Trust center link exists but was not read.

telephony.providedNumbers: Not stated; page says SIP connects directly to existing telephony, CCaaS and PBX/UC platforms.

bestFor: Large enterprises and contact centres wanting a managed, governed agent platform with multi-region and multi-language needs.
unknowns: Agent export or data portability terms
